course_info.faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

catalog_course_description: Introducing multimedia design elements; i.e. sound, interactivity, animation and the combination thereof within a graphic presentation.
course_learning_outcomes: Better understanding of personal creative strengths and weaknesses.
Ability to use visual language for communication purposes.
Improvement of design methodology and presentation skills.
course_objective: Strengthening of core design skills from research and ideation to implementation and presentation within the context of today's visual communication materials.

program_requirements.program: Visual Arts and Visual Communications Design
